description: Southeast Regional Partnership for Planning and Sustainability (SERPPAS) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Southeast Regional Partnership for Planning and Sustainability. Environmental and natural resource officials from the states of North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Alabama, Florida, and Mississippi, along with personnel at the Department of Defense and other federal agencies collaborate as participants in the Southeast Regional Partnership for Planning and Sustainability (SERPPAS). Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
